# Acme Consulting LLC

> Acme Consulting is a strategy and digital transformation firm based in San Francisco. We help mid-market and enterprise organizations navigate change — from market entry and competitive positioning to platform modernization and fractional executive leadership.

Founded in 2010, Acme Consulting brings 15+ years of experience across technology, finance, and healthcare sectors. Our team includes former executives from global consultancies, technology companies and fast-growing startups. We combine rigorous analysis with hands-on execution, embedding with client teams to deliver lasting results — not slide decks.

## Services

- [Services Overview](https://acme-consulting.example.com/services): Acme Consulting offers three core service lines: strategy consulting, digital transformation, and advisory/fractional leadership for mid-market and enterprise organizations.
- [Strategy Consulting](https://acme-consulting.example.com/services#strategy): Market entry and expansion strategy, competitive analysis, growth planning, OKR design, and M&A commercial due diligence for companies with $5M-$500M revenue.
- [Digital Transformation](https://acme-consulting.example.com/services#digital-transformation): Legacy platform migration, data platform architecture, cloud optimization, and AI/ML readiness assessment for CTOs and technology leaders.
- [Advisory & Fractional Leadership](https://acme-consulting.example.com/services#advisory): Fractional CTO/COO engagements, board advisory, investor readiness, post-acquisition integration, and crisis management for boards and executive teams.

## About

- [About Acme Consulting](https://acme-consulting.example.com/about): Founded in 2010 by former consulting and technology leaders. 200+ organizations served across technology, finance, and healthcare. Team of strategists, technologists, and operators.
- [Our Approach](https://acme-consulting.example.com/about#our-approach): Three principles: start with the problem, work alongside (not above), and measure what matters. Every engagement has clear success criteria defined collaboratively.

## Pricing

We offer flexible engagement models tailored to your needs and budget.

- Strategy Workshop: Half-day: $2,500, Full-day: $4,500
- Digital Transformation Assessment: 2 weeks: $15,000, 4 weeks: $28,000
- Fractional Leadership: 1 day/week: $5,000/month, 2 days/week: $9,000/month

Payment: Net 30 invoicing. Major credit cards and wire transfer accepted.
Insurance: Professional liability insurance up to $2M per engagement.
Cancellation: 48-hour cancellation policy. Rescheduling available at no charge with 24-hour notice.
